text: The 2021 tree-cover loss within the rural property (ASSET-A) is supported by independent evidence. The Hansen Global Forest Change dataset (GFC-2025-v1.13) mapped a tree-cover loss of approximately 81.3 hectares in 2021. This observation is corroborated by the JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 (GFC2020 V4) dataset, which agrees on 98% of the event area. Additionally, the MGAP forest map 2021 indicates that the area affected was planted forest, specifically Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda. The evidence supports the occurrence of tree-cover loss but does not specify the cause or legality of the change.
